{{LRdoc}}# SECTION - G # Door-Step Banking for Senior Citizens and Differently-Abled ## Introduction Reserve Bank of India advised Banks to have a scheme for providing services on the doorstep of its customers with the approval of the Board. This document enumerates a comprehensive policy setting up a framework within which the Doorstep Banking services would be provided to the customer. RBI guidelines on Doorstep Banking were issued in 1993, 2005, 2007 and 2017. This policy documents takes references from these circulars as a guided reference. ## Definition The term “Door Step Banking" shall include the following services: Pick up of cash for deposit into own accounts. Pick up of instrument (cheques / Remittance forms) for credit to own account. Delivery of cash by withdrawal from own accounts. Delivery of Demand draft and pay order issued by debit to own account. Submission of KYC document by Senior citizen (Citizens aged over 60 years) and differently-abled Any other service which RBI guides from time to time. ## Customer The term customer will be defined as a resident account holder maintains a savings or a current account with Unity Bank. The door step banking service will be offered only on working days of a branch to those customers who satisfy the following conditions. The list of branches where the services are offered shall be displayed on the website of the Bank. Single account holders and Joint Account Holders with Either or Survivor/ Former or Survivor All the KYC document in procession of the bank are in current and there are no deferrals pending on account of documentation The account is operative in nature Inoperative account holders can activate the door step banking after activating the account post submission of the necessary documents. All relevant application / forms are signed by the customer for availing such facility. INTERNAL Version 4.0 Master Policy on Customer Service ## Operating guidelines

The Door step banking service can be offered by the bank through any of the following means. By Banks own regular staff Outsourcing the operations to a Cash management vendor who have national / regional presence with a good track record. The outsourcing to such vendor will be governed by the outsourcing policy of the bank. Through banking correspondents empaneled with the bank. Services provided through outsourcing or through banking correspondents will be through a mutually signed agreement detailing the terms and conditions including charges for executing these services, turnaround time. ## Process of service delivery The service request for Door-Step delivery can be received at the branch or through any secure convenient channel like phone banking, IVR, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking or call center where the requests are authenticated using TPIN or any other acceptable authentication methodology. The service will be offered across all the branches of Unity Bank • These services will be rendered to the customer by the bank ONLY at customer's premises or residence, as per the address registered with the Bank Requests made through branches before 11:00 a.m. will be attended on the same day. Requests made post 11:00 a.m. will be attended on the next working day The limits of cash pickup and delivery will be decided by bank from time to time. This may vary from type of account held to different variant within a single type of accounts. A representative grid but which are subject to change on the limits on cash delivery / pickup are detailed below. # Cash collected from the customer will be issued an acknowledgement by way of receipts / Registered (Mobile no's) SMS / Registered e – mail. For instruments like cheques the customers will be informed about the probable date of credit into the account through suitable means like SMS (To registered mobile no.) Email id (registered with the bank). Use of technology is encouraged to credit / debit the customer on real time basis. The bank will make true efforts (On Best effort basis) to complete the request on the day of on-boarding of the request before 11 a.m. However, in scenarios where the bank is unable to complete the request on the same day in spite of receiving the instruction before 11 a.m., the customer will be informed accordingly, to avoid further inconvenience. Version 4.0 Master Policy on Customer Service INTERNAL ## Service Charges Service charges for door step banking if any will be levied on customers account basis a preagreed schedule of charges communicated through an official communication / brochures / schedule of charges / web site etc. The Bank may decide to charge the customer differentially basis the cost it incurs in delivering such services or by different variant of account or by size of the relationship with the bank. Any change in the service charges will be intimated to customers through any of the modes o Websites o Mobile banking alerts o Notice Boards o SMS / email to registered email id or registered mobile numbers The Bank shall inform at least 1 month in advance of any change to the schedule of charges on account of door step banking services. ## Force Majeure The Bank shall not be liable to compensate customers for delayed credit or delayed delivery / nondelivery of services for reasons beyond the control of the Bank [including but not limited to civil commotion, sabotage, lockout, strike or other labour disturbances, accident, fires, natural disasters or other “Acts of God", war, damage to the bank's facilities or of its correspondent bank(s), absence of the usual means of communication or all types of transportation, etc.] that prevent the bank from performing its obligations within specified service delivery parameters. The roles and responsibilities of employees of USFB are detailed herein at each specific stage. ## Table of Contents Section 1: Know Your customer process ....11 1.1 Account Opening – Retail Accounts ....11 1.2 Inoperative Accounts....31 1.3 Customer Risk Categorization ....31 1.4 Screening of the customer while On-Boarding....34 1.5 Central KYC Records Registry (CKYCR) record creation ....34 1.6 On-Boarding of the customers on Holiday or after Branch working Hours ....40 1.7 On-Boarding of Staff additional rate of interest:....43 1.8 Account portability or Home Branch Change ....44 1.9 Scheme Code Change ....47 1.10 Closure of accounts ....48 1.11 Appointment of Mandate Holder, POA and LOA ....50 1.12 Abbreviations....54 #UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL ## Section 1: Know Your customer process ## 1.1 Account Opening – Retail Accounts Individuals can open an account in a single name or in joint capacity. Joint holders will be family members / close relatives. A joint account can be opened with nonrelatives in an exceptionally rare case subject to approval from Cluster Heads, which should be handled with caution. Savings / Term Deposit Accounts of a Minor up to the age of 10 years or more can be opened by a natural guardian (including mother as guardian) or otherwise by a guardian appointed by a Court of Law or by Testamentary guardian (Guardian appointed through probated will). In such cases, a probate of the will should be obtained from the claimants. Minors above such an age limit not less than 10 years (who are literate) and up to such amount and such terms as may be fixed by the banks keeping in view their risk management policy, may be allowed to open and operate savings/ term deposit accounts independently, if they so desire, and such terms shall be duly conveyed to the account holder. In such accounts, nomination form should be signed by the guardian. Politically Exposed Persons” (PEPs) i.e. individuals who are or have been entrusted with prominent public functions in a foreign country, e.g., Heads of States/Governments, senior politicians, senior government/judicial/military officers, senior executives of stateowned corporations, important political party officials, etc. A. When a customer approaches the bank for opening an account, a general interview/customer due diligence is conducted by Bank official (RM) to understand the need of the customer and accordingly account opening form, Personal Information Sheet (PIS), KYC Documents and recent photograph. FATCA form is incorporated in the PIS form wherein account holders must declare their tax residency status. If customer is declaring Multi-Tax Residency or Non-Resident of India, separate FATCA Form is to be obtained from customer with proper TIN Number and other details. Details of KYC documents to be obtained which is acceptable for Customer Identification are as below. The documents obtained should be verified with original - a. Any one Officially Valid Documents (OVD) - the passport, the driving license, proof of possession of Aadhaar number, the Voter's Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India, job card issued by NREGA duly signed by an officer of the State Government and letter issued by the National Population Register containing details of name and address. #UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL b. Permanent Account Number (PAN) or the equivalent e- document thereof or Form No. 60 as defined in Income- tax Rules (Only in case where PAN has not been issued). c. PAN & ADHAAR submitted by customer must be invariably linked to each other. {The Aadhaar copy has to be submitted if customer is desirous to avail any benefit or subsidy under any scheme notified under section 7 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 (18 of 2016)} d. In the event of any mismatch in the OVDs submitted by the customer e.g. DOB, name, father/spouse name etc. Adequate due diligence should be carried out by branch official to satisfy himself as to the bonafide’s of the customer and that none of the documents being examined are fabricated. Once the branch official is satisfied on the above counts, then a declaration may be obtained for the same. B. Where the OVD furnished by the customer does not have updated address, the following documents or the equivalent e-documents there of shall be deemed to be OVDs for the limited purpose of proof of address: - Registered Sale Agreement or Registered & Valid Leave and License Agreement to be obtained for Current address. ## OR ## Any one of the following Deemed OVDs can be obtained a. Utility bill which is not more than two months old of any service provider (electricity, telephone, post-paid mobile phone, piped gas, water bill). b. Property or Municipal tax receipt. c. Pension or family pension payment orders (PPOs) issued to retired employees by Government Departments or Public Sector Undertakings if they contain the address. d. Letter of allotment of accommodation from employer issued by State Government or Central Government Departments, statutory or regulatory bodies, public sector undertakings, scheduled commercial banks, financial institutions and listed companies and leave and license agreements with such employers allotting official accommodation. #UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL Within 3 months the customer shall submit an updated OVD with current address to the Bank. If the customer does not provide OVD with updated Address, then the account will be Debit freezed. Contact Point Verification (CPV), for proof of address is discontinued w.e.f. 04.04.2025. Customer on-boarded through Mobile application by Aadhaar authentication With the reference to the RBI Master Direction REF: RBI/DBR/2015-16/18 Master Direction DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 dated February 25, 2016 (Updated as on June 12, 2025) which mentions the below: where the customer has submitted Aadhaar number under clause (a) above to a bank or to a RE notified under first proviso to sub-section (1) of section 11A of the PML Act, such bank or RE shall carry out authentication of the customer’s Aadhaar number using e-KYC authentication facility provided by the Unique Identification Authority of India. Further, in such a case, if customer wants to provide a current address, different from the address as per the identity information available in the Central Identities Data Repository, he may give a self-declaration to that effect to the RE. With reference to RBI Master Directions , if Retail customer is on boarded through Mobile App., where Aadhaar authentication is carried out for the customer’s Aadhaar number using e-KYC authentication facility provided by UIDAI, in such a case, if customer wants to provide a current address, different from the address as per the identity information available in the Central Identities Data Repository, we can obtain self-declaration to update the same for communication Address. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) to be conducted in case of High-Risk customers. E- KYC documents can be accepted for account opening with Customer Due Diligence. In such cases branch should share the documents to CAOC for verification of Signature and KYC documents from the issuing authority site. KYC should be obtained for all joint holders of the account. Customer Due Diligence should be performed for all the joint holders. ## (II) Individual An Individual who is competent to contract can open an account in his/her single name with MOP as singly. Branch staff should explain the benefits of nomination and should insist name of nominee to be mentioned on the nomination form (DA1). # UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL Current account can also be opened in the name of individuals who are running a business in their individual names (transactions in such accounts should be in consistent with business declared). For individual current account declaration from customer stating nature of business activity should be obtained along with OVD of customer. For current account in individual name will be handled at CPC. CIF creation and opening of account will be done at CPC. Branches to collect the AOF and documents and sent to CPC for further processing in CBS. ## Following documents needs to be obtained for opening individual account: - i) Account opening form (Savings/ Current Account -for resident individual) ii) OVD of customer (Refer point no 1.1 A, B, C) iii) Latest photograph of customer iv) Nomination Form (DA1) PAN card or Form 60 vi) Terms & conditions page vii) Declaration from customer stating nature of business (in case of individual current account) ## (III) Joint Account Joint account is an account where two or more persons open an account in their joint names. A joint Savings/Term deposits account can be opened with non-relatives in exceptional rare case subject to approval from Cluster Heads which should be handled with caution. Branch should ensure that no business transactions are carried out from Joint Savings Account. ## Following documents need to be obtained for opening Joint account: - a) Account opening form (Savings/ current account- For resident individuals). b) Separate PIS should be obtained for joint holder. c) If Nomination required is selected as YES on AOF, nomination form should be obtained separately. Nomination form Should signed by all account holders d) OVD of all account holders. e) Pan Card / Form 60 of all holders. f) Terms & conditions page signed by all holders. g) Latest photograph of all holders. #UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL ## (IV)Minor Accounts: • Minor accounts where age of the minor is Below 18 years: - i. Any document issued by competent authority / OVD of the minor having date of birth mentioned. ii. Pan Card/Form 60 of the guardian. iii. OVD of the guardian. iv. FATCA declaration form signed by the guardian in front of bank staff (FATCA form is incorporated in the PI sheet only) v. Photo of the guardian • Minor accounts where age of the minor is above the age of 10 years: - i. OVD of the minor Pan Card/Form 60 of the guardian iii. FATCA declaration form signed by the guardian. (FATCA form is incorporated iv. Photo of the guardian v. OVD of the guardian for purpose of CKYC ## Account opening of illiterate person: The rules relating to Savings Bank or other deposit account must be clearly explained to an illiterate person intending to open such accounts in a language in which he/she understands. He / she shall be advised that for withdrawing money from his/her account, he/she must personally come to the Bank with the Passbook, every time. It is advised that Left thumb impression in case of a male person, and right thumb impression in case of a female person of the constituent has to be obtained on the Account Opening Form in the presence of an authorized Bank officer and a person well known to the Bank who shall attest his thumb impression on the Account Opening Form as witness along with the witness details.(Name ,address, a/c no, etc) Bank official who is obtaining thumb impression shall affix his/her signature near the thumb impression and add the words “Left/Right hand thumb impression of Mr./Mrs./MS”. A declaration shall be taken from the illiterate depositor on the account opening form to the effect that the contents of account opening form as also the rules governing the deposit account have been explained to him, that he / she has fully understood the rules and that he had affixed his thumb impression after fully knowing the rules. This declaration shall be authenticated by the depositor by affixing his thumb impression and it shall be countersigned by a witness. #UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL In The case of an illiterate person, it shall be prominently written on account opening form that the account is of an “illiterate person”. Photograph and thumb impression of the person shall be scanned and stored in the CBS system to verify the identity The Pass Books of such customers should invariably have photographs, attested by the bank, pasted in the inner front page or the space provided in the passbook for the purpose. Cheque Book shall not be issued to him under any circumstances and third-party cash withdrawal cannot be made. Usually, no joint account of illiterate with literate person are opened by the Bank as illiterates are gullible and are prone to cheating by the literate. However, it may be allowed in case of joint account between close relatives with genuine request, but adequate safeguard shall be taken to avoid any inappropriate use. Such account shall be opened with the condition that both can only jointly operate it. No cheque book shall be issued even for such joint accounts. During the operations in the accounts whenever the passing officer or authorized official notices a visible change in the resemblance of the photograph with the customer, particularly in the case of illiterate customers, a recent photograph shall be obtained from the customer, duly attested and affixed at all appropriate places. In such case, fresh AOF should be obtained from the customer where the latest photograph should be affixed and thereafter filed with the earlier AOF submitted by the customer. Payment shall be made in the presence of one witness who is preferably a close relative. Signature and name of the witness shall be obtained on the withdrawal slip. • Current account shall not be opened in the name of an illiterate person. #UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL ## Declaration to be obtained by illiterate person while opening CASA/TD account as format enclosed: To, Date: Unity Small Finance Bank Limited (“Bank”) Dear Sir / Sirs, \_, aged \_years, Indian, residing at agree, confirm and solemnly declare as follows: 1. I wish to open Savings / Fixed deposit Account with branch of the Bank (“Account”). 2. I am an illiterate person. 3. I am of sound mind and competent to contract. 4. The terms and conditions in relation to the Account and the Account opening form as also the rules governing the deposit account have been explained to me by the Bank officials and I have fully understood the said rules. 5. I have affixed my thumb impression to this document after fully knowing the said terms and conditions as well as the rules. I hereby confirm that the contents of this declaration have been explained to me by (name of the staff) in the presence of the witnesses mentioned hereinbelow and I have understood the same. Signature/Thumb Impression of the Account Holder Mr./Ms. Signature of Bank official Mr./Ms. attesting thumb impression. Witness: 1. Name: Address: Account Number (Note: if the witness is not an account holder of the Bank, then obtain KYC of the witness) Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. #UNITY Small Finance Bank INTERNAL ## Account opening of Sick, old or Incapacitated person: The cases of sick / old / incapacitated account holders fall into following categories: The following are two categories of incapacitated persons: A) An account holder who is too ill to sign a cheque/ be physically present in the Bank to withdraw money from his account but can put his/her thumb impression on the cheque/withdrawal form. B) An account holder who is not only unable to be physically present in the bank but is also not able to put his/her thumb impression on the cheque/withdrawal form due to certain physical defect/incapacity. In such cases, the thumb/toe impression of the customer shall be obtained. The thumb/toe impression should be identified by two individuals, one being preferably a close relative of the customer and the other being a responsible official of the Bank. When no impression is possible, a mark from any part of the body shall be obtained on the cheque, the mark needs to be described and should be identified by two individuals one being a close relative of the customer and the other being a responsible official of the Bank. On the question of opening a bank account of a person who had lost both his hands and could not sign the withdrawal form, the signature can be obtained by means of a mark. This mark can be placed by the person in any manner. It could be the toe impression, or it can be by means of mark which anybody can put on behalf of the person who has to sign, the mark being put by an instrument which has had a physical contact with the person who has to sign”. Account opening of Blind / Visually Impaired persons (i.e. persons with difficulty in viewing which means they are not totally blind) ## B) Blind • There shall be no legal bar for a blind to open a bank account. • The Bank may at its discretion open deposit accounts other than current account in the name of the blind person after observing all necessary formalities. # UNITY Small Finance Bank Unity Small Finance Bank Ltd. INTERNAL While there is no legal provision for appointment of a guardian for the blind person, the Bank may at its discretion, allows a properly constituted attorney to operate the account on behalf of the blind account holder. However, in the cases where the Bank is satisfied on merits, the next of kin of the blind person may be allowed to operate the account as constituted attorney duly authorized by a letter of authority or power of attorney as may be considered expedient. • Signature of the blind person in the Account Opening Form shall be attested by a witness who shall be a person well known to the Bank or a long-standing customer of the Bank. • Whenever inconsistency in the signature of the blind customer is noticed, left thumb impression in case of a male person, and right thumb impression in case of a female person may be obtained by the Bank in addition to his signature. • In the case of blind person, it shall be prominently written on account opening form as “Blind”, and photograph shall be scanned and stored in the computer system. ## C) Visually Impaired Person Bank can open deposit accounts of visually impaired person.
